categories.data: the record of each sync of the owner's collection: when it ran, what started it, its outcome and reason code, how many attempts it took, and whether it downloaded the whole collection
categories.purpose: running the daily sync, showing the owner its outcome, and paging when it stops

categories.data: the record of each skip day: the study day, how many reviews were due, whether the skip was applied, failed or undone, and how many cards it moved; and, for each moved card, its id and its scheduling before the skip and as the skip left it; and, beside the private copy of the collection, the one backup of that copy a skip day's write makes before it changes a card, which an erase removes and an export leaves out
categories.purpose: showing the skip day and its cost, bridging the streak over it, and undoing it exactly

categories.data: what the last recompute of the owner's reviews saw (the newest review's id, the card count and its fingerprint, the study day, when it ran and the settings generation it read), whether the owner asked for a rescore, the reason and the time a request of the owner was refused, and the base of the review window
categories.purpose: recomputing the owner's scores only when their collection or their settings changed

categories.data: the record of each proposal to move one of the owner's presets to the scheduler's default parameters: the preset's id and name, the parameters it would replace and the field they came from, the proposed parameters, the preset's desired retention, how many non-new cards the change recomputes, whether the proposal is open, moved or diverged, when that was seen, and whether the desired retention was kept
categories.purpose: proposing the scheduler's defaults for a preset when the owner asks, keeping the values that undo the change, and settling the proposal once the owner's change has synced

categories.data: the settings generation: one counter of how many times the owner's settings changed, and a digest of the owner's courses file, which says whether the file changed
categories.purpose: telling the recompute that a setting or the courses changed

categories.data: every XP grant: the study day it pays for, an opaque token of what it was for, the track, the amount, whether it pays once a study day or once ever, and when it was written
categories.purpose: keeping the owner's XP total and level, and paying each award at most once

categories.data: the XP each study day earned, settled once per source and track: the study day, the source, the track, the amount, whether the day had closed, and when it was written
categories.purpose: keeping the owner's XP total and level from the reviews and the day's bonuses, settled once per source

categories.data: each badge you earned: its key, tier, name, emoji, the study day, and when its celebration was sent
categories.purpose: showing the badges you hold and sending each celebration once

categories.data: your best daily score, most reviews and most minutes: the value, the study day, the value it beat, and when its celebration was sent
categories.purpose: showing your personal records and sending each celebration once

categories.data: the buffs a study day holds: the study day, the kind of buff, and when it was armed
categories.purpose: carrying the Ascendant bonus from the day that earned it to the day that gets it

categories.data: the record of each resolution of the owner's readings for a study day: what started it, the study day, when it ran, its outcome with its class and reason when it was refused as a whole, and how many decks with new cards mapped to no topic
categories.purpose: resolving the owner's daily readings, and showing the owner why a study day has none

categories.data: each reading topic's state for each study day, with its class and reason, and for a topic with new cards the ids of those cards and of their notes, their count and their digest
categories.purpose: giving each reading topic one honest state each study day, and the new cards its reading primes

categories.data: the record of each AI duty run: the duty, the persona template, the subject, how the run ended with its cause or its class, the turns, the tokens and the cost the run reported, and how long it took; never the prompt and never the reply
categories.purpose: showing the owner why a duty delivered nothing, and keeping each run's cost visible

categories.data: each study day's rollup of the owner's reviews: the counts by kind of answer, the seconds answering, the true retention and its young and mature split, the graduations and the decks studied; the card state recorded for the day with when it was recorded; the five-pillar score, the score the day closed with and when it was settled; and a fingerprint of the day's reviews
categories.purpose: scoring each study day once it closes, and showing the owner each day's numbers and score

categories.data: each course's reviews, seconds answering, first answers and passes on each study day, by the course's code
categories.purpose: showing the owner how each study day's work was split across their courses

categories.data: each course's progress at the last recompute: its name and flag, its mastery, its current band and unit, its mature and total cards and each band's counts; and each band a course reached: the study day, whether it was the course's first sighting, and when its celebration was sent
categories.purpose: showing the owner's progress toward C2 in each course, and paying and celebrating each band reached once

categories.data: the law track's review cards overdue and due on the study day at the last recompute, and that study day
categories.purpose: showing the owner's law dues in the law block, and showing them as pending before the first count

categories.data: every decision the notification router made about an occasion: its opaque key, its kind, the surface, whether it was sent, deferred or withheld and why, the tier asked for and the tier rendered, and the study day
categories.purpose: keeping one record of why each celebration or nudge was sent, held or withheld

categories.data: each delivered occasion's opaque key with its kind, the scope it holds that key in, the surface, the study day and the lapse it belongs to
categories.purpose: delivering each celebration or nudge at most once across the bot and the Mini App, and capping comebacks per lapse

categories.data: the celebrations held by quiet hours or a failed send: their text, key, kind and tiers, why and since when they are held, and how often a send failed
categories.purpose: delivering a held celebration once quiet hours end or sends succeed, and naming every one that is abandoned

categories.data: the celebrations delivered to the Mini App: their text, key, kind and tier, and when the Mini App fetched them
categories.purpose: showing the owner in the Mini App the celebrations raised there

categories.data: the owner's notification settings: which kinds are switched off, and the owner's quiet hours
categories.purpose: honouring the owner's choices about which notifications to receive and when to stay quiet

categories.data: the id of the owner's latest message to the bot and when it arrived
categories.purpose: reacting to the owner's latest message when a small celebration lands

categories.data: each track's streak: the days running now, the longest run, the freezes held, the last study day and whether a comeback is armed
categories.purpose: showing you your language and law streaks and keeping them from one study day to the next

categories.data: each freeze gained or spent: the study day, the change and why it happened
categories.purpose: keeping the count of freezes you hold and limiting how many you can gain in a month

categories.data: the habit strength of each study day: the study day and its value
categories.purpose: deciding whether the governor is armed and showing you how steady your habit is

categories.data: the study days whose relight was granted and whose celebration is not yet decided
categories.purpose: celebrating each relight once, also when DeckStreak restarts before the celebration is sent

categories.data: the governor's one row: the day a lapse began, whether it is on standby and the day you were last told
categories.purpose: keeping one lapse and one notice from repeating on every study day

categories.data: every coin movement of the wallet: the study day it belongs to, what moved the coins and which one, the signed amount and when it was written
categories.purpose: keeping the owner's coin balance, its daily loss cap and its floor, and paying each movement at most once

categories.data: the shop's one row: when the active scroll pass ends and when the pass surcharge ends
categories.purpose: knowing whether a scroll pass is active and what the next one costs

categories.data: every chest you earned: the study day, whether a study session, the daily challenge or the weekly quest earned it, the session's start, its rarity, the XP it pays, its state, the Epic prize you chose and whether its arrival was announced
categories.purpose: rolling each chest once, paying it once on the study day it was earned, and never rolling the same session again

categories.data: the pity row: how many chests came since your last Epic and since your last Legendary
categories.purpose: guaranteeing an Epic and a Legendary after a fixed run of chests

categories.data: every double-XP token: the chest it came from, when it was granted, when it was activated, when its window ends and whether it is spent
categories.purpose: activating each token once, opening its two-hour window, and paying its bonus at most once per study day

categories.data: the chest settings' one row: the most chests a study day holds and the hour from which a new chest is vaulted
categories.purpose: honouring your choices of how many chests a study day holds and when they wait in the vault

categories.data: which law drills the owner answered, from which surface and on which study day, and each graded drill's type, subject, accepted XP and the study day it was graded; never a drill's text or an answer, which stay in the owner's notes
categories.purpose: answering each drill once, paying each graded drill once, and telling the agent which drill types and subjects the owner practised

categories.data: each capture the owner sent to the vault inbox from the bot or the Mini App: its stem, its retry key, its kind, its source, its attachment's file name, the instant it was captured, and whether and where it was filed; the captions, texts and attachments themselves stay in the owner's vault
categories.purpose: saving each capture in the vault inbox once, answering a resend with the first capture's name, and letting the inbox curator file it; no model reads a capture unless the curator's route is configured, and a journal capture never

categories.data: the latest report of each research instrument that reads the owner's collection: the study day it was built for, its shape version, its findings about the owner's own cards and note types, and the name of each read that failed
categories.purpose: showing the owner what each instrument last found, and running each weekly instrument once in seven study days

categories.data: each reading entry the owner logged: the course's code, the study day, the minutes, an optional free-text note of up to 200 characters, and the instant it was written
categories.purpose: settling each course's reading XP of the day and its weekly bonus from the entries, and removing the newest entry when the owner undoes it

categories.data: each study day the owner confirmed writing in a writing course: the course code, the study day, and when it was confirmed
categories.purpose: earning the writing XP and counting the writing streaks

categories.data: each passkey the owner registered for signing in on the web: its credential id, the random user handle every passkey of the owner shares, the stored credential with its public key, the signature counter, the backup state, and when it was added and last used
categories.purpose: signing the owner in on the web with a passkey
